$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (marketing-mail-transports). Adds the mailTransport schema — a per-tenant sending route for the marketing blast engine — and a transportId reference on the existing blast schema (95-marketing-segmentation-blast.json). components.registers.pipelinq.schemas and components.objects are additive-list paths (ConfigFileLoaderService::ADDITIVE_LIST_PATHS), so this fragment unions its schema slug and seed objects onto the monolith and its sibling fragments rather than replacing them. mailTransport never stores a provider credential: a provider-kind row carries only a connectorSourceId reference (ADR-064/067/091, mirroring channelProvider.sourceId in 80-whatsapp-sms-channel.json) and a mailAccount-kind row carries only the Mail app's numeric account id. The instance-kind row needs neither — IMailer is always present.

mailTransport.title: Mail Transport
mailTransport.summary: A per-tenant email sending route: the instance mail server, a sender's Mail account, or a bulk provider.
mailTransport.description: MailTransport names one route a blast can send through. kind=instance uses the Nextcloud instance's own mail server (IMailer) and needs no further configuration — every tenant gets one, seeded and marked default. kind=mailAccount sends through the sender's own Nextcloud Mail account (mailAccountRef, the Mail app's numeric account id) for low-volume sends. kind=provider sends through a bulk email provider (Amazon SES, Brevo, Mailjet, SendGrid, Mailgun or Postmark) addressed by connectorSourceId — credentials live on that OpenConnector source, never here. Exactly one transport should carry default=true; MailTransportService falls back to it when a blast names no transportId. dailyLimit (0 = no cap) is enforced against sentToday, which resets at dailyLimitResetAt. dkimVerified and dmarcStatus cache the deliverability panel's DNS lookup for senderDomain so the panel does not re-query DNS on every page load.

kind.description: Which route this transport sends through.
kind.title: Kind

displayName.description: Tenant-visible label shown in the transport step and the deliverability panel.
displayName.title: Display Name

provider.description: The bulk provider behind a kind=provider transport. Selects the adapter's per-provider request mapping. Ignored for other kinds.
provider.title: Provider

connectorSourceId.description: OpenConnector source id or slug that transports a kind=provider send. Credentials and the provider base URL live on that source; this row carries routing metadata only. Required when kind=provider.
connectorSourceId.title: Connector Source ID

mailAccountRef.description: The Nextcloud Mail app's numeric account id (AccountService::find expects an int) for a kind=mailAccount transport, stored as a numeric string. Required when kind=mailAccount.
mailAccountRef.title: Mail Account Reference

senderDomain.description: The domain in the sender address this transport sends from, used to key the deliverability panel's SPF/DKIM/DMARC lookup.
senderDomain.title: Sender Domain

dailyLimit.description: Maximum messages this transport may send per day (0 = no cap). Enforced alongside the existing per-OpenConnector-source rate limit.
dailyLimit.title: Daily Limit

sentToday.description: Messages already sent through this transport since dailyLimitResetAt. Advanced by MailTransportService on each accepted send.
sentToday.title: Sent Today

dailyLimitResetAt.description: ISO 8601 instant sentToday last reset. MailTransportService rolls the counter when this falls on an earlier calendar day than the current send.
dailyLimitResetAt.title: Daily Limit Reset At

dkimVerified.description: Cached result of the deliverability panel's DKIM DNS lookup for senderDomain.
dkimVerified.title: DKIM Verified

dmarcStatus.description: Cached result of the deliverability panel's DMARC DNS lookup for senderDomain.
dmarcStatus.title: DMARC Status

deliverabilityCheckedAt.description: ISO 8601 instant the SPF/DKIM/DMARC cache (dkimVerified, dmarcStatus) was last refreshed.
deliverabilityCheckedAt.title: Deliverability Checked At

active.description: Whether this transport may be selected for a send. An inactive transport stays visible in the panel but is not offered in the wizard.
active.title: Active

default.description: Whether this is the transport a blast uses when it names no transportId. Exactly one transport should carry default=true; the seeded instance transport does.
default.title: Default

mock.description: Whether this is a placeholder transport shipped for demonstration, with no live connectorSourceId credential behind it. Mirrors channelProvider.sandbox (80-whatsapp-sms-channel.json) and OpenConnector's configuration.mock convention.
mock.title: Mock

transportId.description: FK to mailTransport (UUID or slug). When empty, MailTransportService uses the transport marked default=true.
transportId.title: Transport ID
